text:
incident-bot: Pager: P0 — inference-api 5xx spike in eu-west during traffic shift. Alert rules: error_rate > 5% for 3m. Links: https://monitoring/redwood/alerts/12345

alice: Oncall alice here. We kicked a blue->green traffic shift for eu-west at ~03:12 UTC (gradual weights). Observed 502s starting ~03:14. Investigating.

ben: Looking at envoy logs on gw-eu-02, lots of upstream reset_by_peer, connection refused. Also seeing tcp retransmits.

carol: Can you paste the rollout command? Was there a proxy config flip (VHost) with the release? :thinking_face:

alice: rollout job: `kubectl -n infra run rollout-20260317 --image=ops/rollout:stable --args="--service=inference-api --region=eu-west --strategy=bluegreen --step=50"`

alice: Logs from gw-eu-02 (tail):
```
[03:13:58] envoy proxy: upstream reset_by_peer, conn_id=4821
[03:14:05] kernel: nf_conntrack: table full, dropping packet
[03:14:07] application: 502 write failed, backend connection reset
```

ben: nf_conntrack is spiking on the host pool. Conntrack entries jumped from 120k -> 640k in a minute. Possible conntrack leak or sudden connection storm from new backend variant.

infra-bot: Auto-scaling didn't add new gateway instances due to scale lock. Scale lock: release-window. Suggest temporary lift?

alice: For immediate mitigation: 1) pause rollout / flip weights back to blue 2) enable kill-switch feature flag to stop new backend variant 3) clear conntrack on affected nodes carefully.

carol: +1. Execute kill-switch first to stop routing to green. Who can run the flag? @alice or @ben?

alice: Running kill-switch (feature flag service): `POST https://flags.redwood/api/v1/flags/inference-eu/green => false`

infra-bot: Feature flag update accepted. All routers re-evaluating routes.

ben: Initiating weight rollback: `ops-rollout rollback --service inference-api --region eu-west --to blue` — started 03:16:42 UTC.

alice: Clearing conntrack on gw-eu-0[1-3] after graceful drain: `for h in gw-eu-01 gw-eu-02 gw-eu-03; do ssh $h sudo conntrack -F; done` (drained connections first).

dan: Customer impact: initial estimate ~18% of eu-west traffic affected; external customers seeing 502s intermittently. Notifying CS and product ops.

carol: Any sign the new backend has a socket leak? Logs from backend-green pods show long-lived CLOSE_WAITs and high fd usage.

ben: Backend-green has an HTTP client library bug — not closing connections on pooled clients under contention. Spiking file descriptors and ephemeral port exhaustion.

alice: Rollback completed at 03:18:12 UTC, traffic returned to blue. Error rate dropping. Metrics: 5xx -> normal within ~90s.

incident-bot: Incident timeline updated: started=3912345678 (03:12 UTC) mitigated=3912345700 (03:18 UTC). Pager cleared.

carol: Initiating postmortem ticket and blameless postmortem. Action items: 1) revert library change in backend package 2) add conntrack guard / alert to runbook 3) remove scale lock during critical rollouts or document exceptions.

ben: I'll own the backend code revert and test fix.

alice: Handoff: I'm paged out in 30m, @ben you take oncall for follow-ups. I'll update oncall roster.

ben: Ack. Monitoring will watch for residual slowdowns.

dan: CS note sent: "We experienced elevated 502s in eu-west during a regional rollout; mitigation applied; brief customer impact for ~6 minutes. Eng investigating root cause."

carol: Closing notes: keep this incident open until postmortem draft posted. Assigning incident lead: carol.

alice: Thanks team. :thumbsup:
